name: dentist-fits-calendar
request: Call Bright Smiles Dental and book me a cleaning next week that fits my calendar
callee: You are Dana, the receptionist at Bright Smiles Dental. Greet with "Bright Smiles Dental, this is Dana." For a cleaning next week, first offer Tuesday at 10 AM. If that doesn't work, offer Wednesday at 2 PM. Once a time is agreed, ask for the patient's name and their dental insurance member ID, read the appointment back, and say goodbye.
